name: Cloudflare Turnstile
label: Turnstile Siteverify API v0 (server-side)
description: Official Turnstile Siteverify via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/server-side-validation/. POST https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify. Tokens expire after 300 seconds and are single-use. Not the Cloudflare DNS/zone API. Auth type none: siteverify expects JSON/form field secret (config secret). Server-side only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path/query/body keys match api_spec.json.

schema.label: response
schema.description: Token from cf-turnstile-response (max 2048 chars). Required. Valid ~300 s, single-use.

schema.label: idempotency_key
schema.description: Optional UUID for safe transport retry of the same token.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Secret
configurationParameters.description: Turnstile widget secret. Sent as Siteverify body field secret. Never on INPUT or in the frontend.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Tokens expire in 300 s. Default 15.
